## Engineering

### Agent Host Protocol (AHP)

As part of rearchitecting how agent sessions work in VS Code, we are adopting the [Agent Host Protocol](https://microsoft.github.io/agent-host-protocol/) (AHP). AHP lets us connect and render the same agent session from multiple clients and VS Code windows at the same time.

This unlocks scenarios like seeing the same session in both a regular VS Code window and the Agents window. The work is ongoing, but you can already try it out in VS Code Insiders and we would welcome [your feedback](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues).
